notes.config-catalog/*: 35 runtime keys read from IServerConfigGrain that ConfigKeyCatalog does not list, so the dashboard's config editor cannot show them. Pet tuning (11) and fishing (16) say in their own doc comments that they exist to be retuned from the dashboard. Fix by adding the descriptors, not by keeping the baseline.
notes.inbound-chain/GiveStarGemToUserMessage: Deliberate: the client removed the packet in 2026 (Headers.cs sets the id to -1). The handler and parser are dead weight kept for reference.
notes.inbound-chain/SetRelationshipStatusMessa: A real gap: the header id (1773) and the parser both exist, only the MapParser line in UsersMap.cs is missing, so a player can read relationship statuses and never set one.
notes.inbound-chain/ChargeFireworkMessage: A real gap: handler and parser written, no header id and no mapping, so charging a firework never reaches the server.
notes.inbound-chain/class_165Message: Unidentified client class, never mapped. Either name it from the client or delete the triplet.
